summary.text: Barb Kniff McCulla is the Republican candidate for Iowa State Senate District 19 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A business owner, she has represented District 37 in the Iowa House of Representatives since 2023 and is not seeking re-election to that seat.

paragraphs.text: Barb Kniff McCulla's career experience includes owning a business.
She assumed office in the Iowa House of Representatives, District 37, on January 1, 2023, succeeding Mike Bousselot, and won the 2022 and 2024 general elections for that seat.
She advanced from the Republican primary for State Senate District 19 on June 2, 2026.
